value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there isn't an open Costco in Oakville yet. One is coming on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, right on the Burlington edge, with a target opening of fall 2027. Burlington already has one, but I couldn't confirm its address or hours. A third-party deals site lists a warehouse at 3180 Laird Rd in Mississauga as serving Oakville, but I couldn't confirm that on Costco's own site, so check before you go.
